extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / editors attempting to create or locate an article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and troubleshooting for users who find that 'Wikipedia does not have an article with this exact name' when attempting to create or locate a page. Covers account requirements, searching for existing content, and diagnosis steps for missing pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users must have an account and autoconfirmed status before creating pages; if not autoconfirmed, consider using the article wizard or other submission routes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the Article Wizard or request a new article / draft submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For users who cannot directly create an article (e.g., not autoconfirmed), submit a draft via the Article Wizard or request a new article for review by experienced editors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for 'People v. Bruce' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, confirm the topic doesn't already exist under a different name or spelling to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspect incoming links to discover if the topic exists under a different title or is mentioned elsewhere; linked pages can indicate redirects or related coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent-creation visibility delay / purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you or someone recently created the page but it's not visible, allow time for propagation or use the purge function to refresh server caches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirect consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants and, if appropriate, create or suggest redirects so readers can find the article under common alternate capitalizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deleted-page diagnosis / check deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the deletion log and explanatory resources to determine whether the topic was removed and why, and what steps (if any) allow re-creation or appeal.
